articles.summary: Granite’s Handley Ranch Quarry in Gonzales sits in the heart of California’s Salinas Valley—one of the most productive agricultural regions in the world. The facility produces roughly 350K tons of materials annually, supplying aggregates for construction, landscape products, and Granite’s nearby asphalt plant in Salinas. Recent water management upgrades and upcoming investments in automation mean the quarry will continue to support infrastructure in the valley for generations.
articles.title: Handley Ranch: Built for the Salinas Valley

articles.summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) announced today that it has been awarded a contract by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) for the construction of a BAK-12/14 aircraft arresting system at Homestead Air Reserve Base in Homestead, Florida. The project is valued at approximately $11 million and will be included in Granite’s third quarter 2026 CAP.Granite’s scope of work includes constructing and installing the BAK-12/14 aircraft arresting system, which provides a critical emergency stopping mechanism for the airfield, as well as runway striping.
articles.title: Granite Awarded Aircraft Arresting System Project in Florida
